method: Read Linux /proc/PID/status VmRSS every 5ms from startup through warm-up and 10,000 requests at concurrency 8; server pinned CPU2, generator pinned CPUs0,1,3-7. Not a hard peak sampler; transient allocations under 5ms may be missed.
publication_path_policy: Workspace and temporary paths are replaced with placeholders; measured values, hashes, commands, and outputs are otherwise retained.
